name: irq_handler
comment: ARM IRQ entry (vector 0x18). Saves state, calls 0x135f5c, then reads the interrupt source byte from 0xFFFFFE03 and BXes through irq_handler_table. Same controller as the ESP9 image.

name: irq_handler_table
comment: Per-source interrupt handler pointers (u32); pointer held at 0x133f40. All 24 entries resolve to code only with load base 0x18000 -- this is what pins the base.

name: e2e_xor_checksum
comment: VAG MLB XOR checksum: chk = seed; for(i=1..len-1) chk ^= data[i]. Byte 0 skipped. Functional twin of the ESP9's 0x118038 (identical 0x1a-byte body).

name: e2e_crc8h2f
comment: AUTOSAR CRC8H2F: crc=0xFF; for(i=1..len-1) crc=tab[crc^data[i]]; return ~tab[crc^dataID]. Table at 0x1a24d4 (copy 0x1a25d4). Twin of the ESP9's 0x118064.

name: crc8h2f_table
comment: CRC8H2F lookup table (poly 0x2F); second copy at 0x1a25d4.

name: e2e_verify_xor
comment: RX check: recompute the XOR checksum and compare against byte 0 (writes the computed value back). Twin of the ESP9's 0x118096.

name: e2e_verify_crc8h2f
comment: RX check: recompute CRC8H2F and compare against byte 0. Twin of the ESP9's 0x1180b2.

name: sig_pack
comment: Generic signal pack primitive (buf, value, startBit, bitLen, msbFirstFlag, frameLen). Equivalent of the ESP9's 0x10129c.

name: e2e_counter_next
comment: Rolling-counter increment per TX frame; state bytes around DAT_00141c7c.

name: e2e_tx_crc_D4
comment: TX E2E wrapper: counter -> sig_pack(bit8,len4); e2e_crc8h2f data ID 0xD4 -> sig_pack(bit0,len8). Same data ID as the ESP9's 0x106494.

name: e2e_tx_crc_AC
comment: TX E2E wrapper, CRC8H2F data ID 0xAC. Same as the ESP9's 0x1064d6.

name: e2e_tx_xor_02
comment: TX E2E wrapper, XOR seed 0x02 -> CAN id 0x103 (ESP_03) by the MLB seed rule.

name: e2e_tx_xor_AA
comment: TX E2E wrapper, XOR seed 0xAA -> ESP_02 (0x101), a known MLB magic Startwert.

name: e2e_rx_crc_F5
comment: RX E2E handler, CRC8H2F data ID 0xF5 -- same as the ESP9's 0xd842a.

name: e2e_rx_xor_10
comment: RX E2E handler, XOR seed 0x10, DLC 8.

name: e2e_rx_xor_8B
comment: RX E2E handler, XOR seed 0x8B, DLC 8. NOT present in the ESP9 image (which instead carries 0xC3 and 0x86).

name: e2e_rx_xor_82
comment: RX E2E handler, XOR seed 0x82, DLC 8.

name: e2e_rx_xor_1A
comment: RX E2E handler, XOR seed 0x1A, DLC 8.
